verdict.rationale: Supermemory has no documented sandbox or test mode. You can approximate one in two ways. First, container tags are hard-boundary namespaces, so a test tag's memories are never returned to production-scoped searches. Second, the self-hosted single binary boots in seconds with zero config on your own hardware, which allows an isolated local instance. Both are workarounds rather than a dedicated sandbox; missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment or test API keys, documentation describing a testing workflow, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
